summary: Core AI Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 18, 2026, attaching a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. The release reports a 58.6% revenue increase to $55.2 million from continuing operations and notes a prior divestment of its legacy Siyata PTT business during Q4 2025. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation filing. The divestiture occurred months earlier and is not the event being filed today, so no special-situation categorization applies.
